stem: Which of the following occurred as a result of these events?

options.label: A
options.text: The president of Mexico refused to withdraw troops from Texas.

options.label: B
options.text: Parts of southern Texas were returned to Mexico.

options.label: C
options.text: The United States acquired several territories from Mexico.

options.label: D
options.text: Mexico was forced to sell Florida to the United States.

visual_elements: 1845 Texas is annexed by the United States.
1845 Mexican and U.S. troops gather near the Texas-Mexico border.
1846 The United States declares war on Mexico.
1847 Mexico accepts a temporary peace settlement.
1848 The Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo is signed.
